title: Subcritical limits of a 1D KPZ growth surface with finite moments
summary: We consider the one-dimensional random growth surface introduced by Adhikari and Chatterjee [AC24], where the height function is defined recursively via the heights at two neighboring sites and an independent noise term at each space-time point. In the subcritical regime, assuming uniformly bounded eighth moments of the noise variables and appropriate regularity of the driving function, we establish convergence in law of the suitably rescaled height function to the solution of the additive stochastic heat equation.
